text_block_list.text: Summer training camp finally came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: We were able to get in a lot of special training.
You got to do plenty of special training, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Preparations for the Shuka Sho are complete.
We'll stay sharp once we get back too.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Vice President~!
Someone still hasn't shown up for roll call~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Urgh, is there no end to this work right up to the very last moment—

Though Air Groove was busy right down to the wire—
it turned out to be a fruitful summer training camp that fostered real growth!
